summary: Test only: the follow-read outage test and the unanswered message send test run on a paused clock, so a loaded host can no longer turn the client's 20 ms connect or 30 ms request deadline into a 5 to 15 second deadline backoff (the follow read) or a send the server never took (the unanswered send, which then waited forever)

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim or projection replay.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: No runtime, client, wire or harness change; only crates/fractal-daemon/src/store_tests/client.rs.
